prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a low-speed head-on collision claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1319; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss for a low-speed head-on collision. Insured reports the other vehicle crossed into their lane on a curve. Both vehicles drivable from scene, tow not required. Claimant reported shoulder pain at the scene and was transported for evaluation. Opened bodily injury and property damage exposures.

Entry 2: Claimant is represented by counsel. Letter of representation received and logged. All further contact to go through the attorney's office. Requested medical authorization and the attorney's itemized treatment summary. Reserves set pending records.

Entry 3: Photos of both vehicles reviewed. Front bumper and grille damage on each, consistent with a low-speed impact. Airbag deployment not reported in either vehicle. Estimate ordered for the insured vehicle and the claimant vehicle. Recorded statement from insured obtained, no inconsistencies noted.

Entry 4: Attorney's office provided initial imaging and orthopedic notes for the right shoulder. Treating physician notes limited range of motion and recommends physical therapy. Prior history of shoulder complaints being requested from the claimant's prior providers. Referred file to medical review for causation assessment.

Entry 5: Medical review completed. Findings support soft tissue strain with possible rotator cuff involvement, pending further imaging. Physical therapy in progress per treating physician. Demand package expected from counsel. Diary set to follow up on records and reassess reserves upon receipt.
